target_customer: Hedge funds, wealth managers, fintechs and individual investors researching public stocks
problem: Equity research data is expensive and hard to verify. Dataglade offers AI generated analyses and models where each figure links to a source in its financial data warehouse.
business_model: B2B and prosumer subscription for data and AI research tools
product_category: AI stock research and financial data terminal

founders.name: Ash Rai
education: Vanderbilt University, degrees in Economics, History and Classics (graduated early)
previous_startups: Hedge fund started in a freshman dorm room, grew to 1 million dollars AUM before age 20 (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was the country's youngest registered investment advisor; a claim not independently verified.

founders.name: Patrick Higgins
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built apps with friends; employers and education not listed. Technical status inferred from the page wording, so treat as unconfirmed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a cited financial data warehouse and LLM analysis layer is standard engineering with hard data quality work.

defensibility.rationale: Data warehouse curation helps, but incumbents like Bloomberg and AlphaSense and cheaper tools like Koyfin could add AI features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AI research tools proliferated in 2024 to 2026 per comparison guides. No acquisition of Dataglade found.

market_need_then: Investors wanted cheaper alternatives to terminals and LLMs created a chance to summarize filings. Specific evidence of Dataglade demand was not found beyond its own claim of informing over 1 billion dollars of trades daily.

identity.visual_style: Blue accent, gray icons, clean product-focused layout (from site description, partly inferred from asset names)
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, claims driven, emphasis on accuracy and verifiability

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand coverage found. The name is easily confused with Dataglide and Glade.ai.

outcome_analysis: Dataglade is active and sells AI research and data tools to investment professionals, with company-stated reach of over 1 billion dollars of trades daily. No funding, exit or independent traction evidence was found, so its trajectory is not verifiable from public sources.
notes: No funding announcement found. Claims on 48,000 companies and 1 billion dollars traded are the company's own. Competition list empty: only 2026 guides found, none dated near the W23 batch.
